name: Andhra Sugars Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1947, Andhra Sugars Limited is a manufacturer of Sugar, Industrial Alcohol, Chlor Alkali Products, Aspirin, Sulphuric Acid, Liquid & Solid Propellants. It also generates power for captive use [1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
1) Chlor-alkali (37% in FY24 vs 38% in FY22): [1] [2] The company offers Chlor-alkali products like caustic soda, caustic potash and its co-products. The segment revenue declined by 6% between FY22 and FY24, due to a significant decline in the realization of caustic soda. [3]

pros: Stock is trading at 0.63 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 24.8%
Promoter holding has increased by 2.66% over last quarter.
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.45% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 6.53% over last 3 years.
